description: Native HumMod diagnostic challenge for autonomic-pathway comparison with the v1.3 reduced browser model. This is not a Berlin ARDS calibration and native HumMod has no PEEP control in this pinned ventilator.

provenance.purpose: Identify the first native-vs-reduced divergence in the HumMod sympathetic CNS to SA-node chain without tuning gains.
limitations: Pinned native HumMod ventilator does not expose PEEP.
This probe matches RR, tidal volume, and nominal inspired oxygen challenge only.
Do not use this scenario as a patient-care model or Berlin ARDS calibration.
